messages.author: 1c042828d73497a7
messages.subject: Issues with day segment analyses
parts:
Hi all,

I'm new to GGIR and I tried to run a day segment analyses with times provided by an activity log. I followed the instructions of the vignette for day segment analyses and no errors or warnings were produced. However, the results contain full day segments only and no columns with times that were provided in the log were included. I tried it with versions 2.5-0 and 2.6-4. 
Does anyone have an idea why this is not working?

That is the code I used:
g.shell.GGIR(datadir = paste0(getwd(), "/Data/"),
             outputdir = paste0(getwd(), "/Output/"),
             mode = 1:2,
             do.report = 2,
             qwindow = paste0(getwd(), "/Log/TimeLog.csv"),
             qwindow_dateformat = "%d-%m-%Y")

I also attach the following files: 
  • TimeLog.csv
  • config.csv
  • part2_daysummary_longformat.csv
  • part2_daysummary.csv

Thank you in advance!

Best wishes,
Justin

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Issues with day segment analyses
parts:
Hi Justin,

In TimeLog.csv I see format "01/02/2022" while in your code I see qwindow_dateformat = "%d-%m-%Y". Have you tried changing it to "%d/%m/%Y" to be in line with your TimeLog.csv. Alternatively you could also try updating your TimeLog.csv date format to the format as specified in the code.

Best wishes,
Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/

Hi Vincent,

thank you for your quick reply! That's strange, in my editor the dates are displayed in the format dd-mm-yyyy. I changed the fileformat in the function nevertheless, but then I got the following warning: 

Warning:
In g.conv.actlog(qwindow, qwindow_dateformat):
Date not recognised in activity diary. We expect format %d/%m/%Y but we see 01-02-2022 11-02-2022 02-02-2022 12-02-2022 03-02-2022 13-02-2022. You need to update the qwindow_dateformat argument, and check that dates are in a consistent format.

I will try to run the analysis on another computer. Do you have any other ideas what I could try?

Best wishes,
Justin
